policy.purpose: Persist official first-party vacancy details for roles explicitly kept by the user when the broad ATS inventory/search does not enumerate them.
policy.verification: A fallback record may be reconciled only from first-party evidence. For Workday roles, the canonical URL must match the mapped ATS host/site. If the Workday detail API is blocked, an official corporate careers listing may prove the role live only when that page contains the exact title and a link/path carrying the same Workday source ID.
policy.lifecycle: These records are discovery/reconciliation hints only; user_job_decisions.json remains authoritative for TO_REVIEW/INTERESTED/APPLIED/NOT_INTERESTED.
